choices.name: alias table
candidates: dense_aliases minus the entries table->desk, chair->seat, stool->seat, office chair->chair, armchair->chair, coffee table->table, dining table->table, nightstand->bedside table
choices.data: K1 abs rows with the P1 selector, G3T scaled by step-544 heads, incumbent depth cut and box rule
choices.rule: keep the incumbent unless a challenger has paired (challenger - incumbent) 95% lower bound > 0 on K1 train AND point estimate > 0 on K1 held-out; among qualifying challengers take the largest K1-train mean; exact ties go to the incumbent
choices.pre_check: if the mask_recall Part-1 dev-S1 lexical-miss table accounts for every alias entry, record that and still run the comparison
choices.default: dense_aliases if the K1 cache covers < 80% of train captures

choices.name: depth cut
choices.data: K1 abs rows, P1 selector masks (decision) and GT masks (reported), box rule best1 with the cut applied
choices.rule: keep the incumbent unless a challenger has paired (challenger - incumbent) 95% lower bound > 0 on K1 train AND point estimate > 0 on K1 held-out; among qualifying challengers take the largest K1-train mean; exact ties go to the incumbent

choices.name: abs box rule
choices.data: K1 abs rows, P1 selector masks (decision) and GT masks (reported), C2 winner as dc
choices.rule: keep the incumbent unless a challenger has paired (challenger - incumbent) 95% lower bound > 0 on K1 train AND point estimate > 0 on K1 held-out; among qualifying challengers take the largest K1-train mean; exact ties go to the incumbent

choices.name: room rule
choices.data: K1 room rows (ScanNet and ScanNet++ only; ARKitScenes has none)
choices.rule: keep the incumbent unless a challenger has paired (challenger - incumbent) 95% lower bound > 0 on K1 train AND point estimate > 0 on K1 held-out; among qualifying challengers take the largest K1-train mean; exact ties go to the incumbent
choices.disclosure: VSI-Bench ARKitScenes room items (150) get a rule chosen without ARKitScenes data

choices.name: near-nadir gravity guard
candidates: sign test only when in-plane up > 0.3 (|pitch| < ~72 deg)
sign test on the median over the 32 frames
choices.data: dev-S1 and K1 captures with GT gravity, plus synthetic inverted and 90-degree-rolled copies of every capture
choices.rule: take the lowest refusal rate among candidates that refuse 100% of synthetic inverted copies; tie -> conditioned test
choices.forbidden_input: the official raw-G3T proxy counts (54 distance, 23 room items)

choices.name: abs distance route (step-544)

arms.route: native routed read: the export's own calls served by the P1-P6 backend
arms.direct: the export's direct-reader answer on the same items (calls unserved, as in ROUTE_PREDICTED.md)

choices.items: all 790 dev-S1 primary abs items (59 rooms); direct answers are needed on the 640 items outside the existing 150-item fixed list
choices.rule: route if paired (route - direct) 95% lower bound > 0; direct if upper bound < 0; else undecided
choices.default_if_undecided: route (the trained behaviour; the claim of a routing gain is withheld)
choices.power: CP1 effect +8.1 had half-width ~8.0 on 150 items/46 rooms; at 59 rooms the projected half-width is ~6-7, enough at effects >= ~7 points

choices.name: room size route (step-544)
choices.items: all 36 dev-S1 primary room items (9 rooms, ScanNet only)
choices.default_if_undecided: direct (calls unserved); report room as not established
choices.power: half-width ~20 on 9 rooms; it cannot decide at +6.7 (CP1) or +3.1 (the official estimate). A decision at +6.7 needs ~80 eligible held-out rooms with room labels; none exist for step-544, because the eligible pool trained it. Withhold >= 80 ScanNet/ScanNet++ rooms with room rows from the next seal's training data to build that set

fixed_clean.choice: proposal density (dense pass, joint 0.05, cap 30, merged cap 100)
linker floor 0.3, mask threshold 0.5, SAM 3 1008 px bf16 batch 1
thinking budget B2048; 2,048 + 64 for native routed reads
frames: trained 32-duplicate layout; 32 anchors with dense 64-frame G3T
VSTI route table: camera displacement and movement route, all else direct
selector features and form (portable_np logistic, top-1, pair merge); coefficients refit under K1
depth source: G3T scaled by the step-544 heads (no V-C depth exists on the native path)

fallback.native_reads: primary = as-served native output (a refusal or a non-answer scores 0); secondary = reader-side fallback to the direct-reader answer, labelled secondary

freeze.content: every value of P1-P7 with its K1/dev-S1 table, the hashes of the K1 cache, refit and this pre-registration
